title: Preserve the Vercel static boundary

requirementAssessments.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml registers only support.runtimeAgent and support.inputSchema. Its prepare-call-static-boundary warning explicitly leaves the instruction loader, output schema, and tool wiring unresolved because prepareCall can replace call settings. Deterministic post-actor inspection is valid.

moldea/moldea.yaml preserves step-support runtimeAgent, inputSchema, outputSchema, and the complete get_status tool bindings. Only the instruction loader is omitted and covered by prepare-step-instruction-boundary because prepareStep can replace instructions. Deterministic inspection is valid.

The delegating-support manifest preserves delegate_support registration, implementation, and schemas without routing, handoff, or subagent relationships. src/delegation.ts calls stepSupportAgent.generate only inside the tool implementation. Workspace assertions show all relevant source files unchanged.

src/workflow-agent.mts remains unchanged and exports workflowSupportAgent using WorkflowAgent. No workflow agent appears in moldea/moldea.yaml; the only reference in canonical material states that it is outside the ToolLoopAgent target.

moldea/runtimes/vercel-ai-sdk.md is the sole new runtime-guidance file and correctly distinguishes prepareCall from prepareStep without provider claims. However, neither support nor step-support references /moldea/runtimes/vercel-ai-sdk.md in moldea/moldea.yaml, and the guidance gives no closed-constructor alternatives.

moldea/moldea.yaml contains separate warning requirements with boundary-specific descriptions and related source symbols. Their resolution fields request callback-aware evidence that preparation outcomes preserve relationships; they do not state the required relationship-specific closed-constructor resolution.

requirementAssessments.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml:7-28 retains only supportAgent and SupportCallOptionsSchema bindings, while prepared-call-wiring explicitly marks instruction, SupportOutputSchema, and supportStatusTool wiring unresolved because prepareCall can replace them. Deterministic inspection and validation passed.

moldea/moldea.yaml:39-75 retains stepSupportAgent, input/output schemas, and all get_status implementation, registration, input-schema, and output-schema bindings. Only instruction provenance is unresolved because prepareStep may replace it.

moldea/moldea.yaml:82-121 preserves delegating-support's runtime, instruction, schemas, and delegate_support tool bindings without routing, handoff, or subagent declarations. src/delegation.ts:1-14 directly calls stepSupportAgent.generate, and workspace assertions show source was unchanged.

src/workflow-agent.mts:1-7 preserves workflowSupportAgent as a WorkflowAgent, while moldea/moldea.yaml contains no workflow target or binding. Only the manifest and runtime-guidance file changed, and guidance explicitly identifies the WorkflowAgent as outside the ToolLoopAgent target.

Both prepared agents reference the sole runtime file, /moldea/runtimes/vercel-ai-sdk.md, and lines 5-6 distinguish prepareCall from prepareStep. However, the file only describes inspection limits; it supplies no closed-constructor alternative for either callback boundary.

moldea/moldea.yaml:14-28 and 65-75 contains separate unresolved entries with boundary-specific descriptions and related source symbols. Their resolutions merely suggest a 'statically supported preparation pattern or deterministic local tests'; they do not state the required relationship-specific closed-constructor resolutions.
